articles.author: Stephen Clark
articles.title: NASA calls off mission to rescue Swift gamma-ray observatory - Ars Technica
articles.description: Without a rescue, NASA's Swift Observatory is expected to reenter the atmosphere later this year.

articles.author: Aisha Malik
articles.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools - TechCrunch
articles.description: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.
articles.content: Google on Wednesday announced a slew of new study tools across Search and Gemini, including AI-generated interactive visuals, 3D simulations, a dedicated student hub, customized practice quizzes, and… [+2962 chars]
